subject: math
question: 计算积分 $I = \iint_{D} \arctan\left(\sqrt{\frac{x - c}{a}} + \sqrt{\frac{y - c}{b}}\right) \mathrm{d}x \mathrm{~d}y$ ，其中 $D$ 由曲线 $\sqrt{\frac{x - c}{a}} + \sqrt{\frac{y - c}{b}} = 1$ 和 $x = c, y = c (a > 0, b > 0, c > 0)$ 所围成.
answer: I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \cdot \frac {2}{3} a b t ^ {3} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{6} a b \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \mat

steps.text: 分析 为化简被积函数，作变量代换 $\sqrt{\frac{x - c}{a}} = \rho \cos^2\varphi, \sqrt{\frac{y - c}{b}} = \rho \sin^2\varphi$ 是较好的选择。但根据被积函数与积分区域的特点（ $D$ 的一条边界曲线是被积函数的等值线），改变面积微元的选取，会使积分更为简单。

方法1 作变量代换： $x = c + a\rho^2\cos^4\varphi ,y = c + b\rho^2\sin^4\varphi$ ，则 $D$ 变为

$$
D ^ {\prime} \colon 0 \leqslant \varphi \leqslant \frac {\pi}{2}, 0 \leqslant \rho \leqslant 1.
$$

又

$$
J = \frac {\partial (x , y)}{\partial (\rho , \varphi)} = \left| \begin{array}{l l} 2 a \rho \cos^ {4} \varphi & - 4 a \rho^ {2} \cos^ {3} \varphi \sin \varphi \\ 2 b \rho \sin^ {4} \varphi & 4 b \rho^ {2} \cos \varphi \sin^ {3} \varphi \end{array} \right| = 8 a b \rho^ {3} \cos^ {3} \varphi \sin^ {3} \varphi ,
$$

所以

$$
I = 8 a b \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \varphi \sin^ {3} \varphi d \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan \rho \cdot \rho^ {3} d \rho ;\tag{①}
$$

其中

$$
\int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} \cos^ {3} \varphi \sin^ {3} \varphi d \varphi = \int_ {0} ^ {\frac {\pi}{2}} (1 - \sin^ {2} \varphi) \sin^ {3} \varphi d \sin \varphi = \frac {1}{1 2},

\begin{array}{r l} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan \rho \cdot \rho^ {3} d \rho & = \frac {1}{4} \rho^ {4} \arctan \rho \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\rho^ {4}}{1 + \rho^ {2}} d \rho \\ & = \frac {\pi}{1 6} - \frac {1}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \left[ (\rho^ {2} - 1) + \frac {1}{1 + \rho^ {2}} \right] d \rho = \frac {1}{6}. \end{array}
$$

上面结果代入①式，得 $I=\frac{1}{9}ab.$

方法2 设被积函数在 $D$ 中的等值线为 $l: \sqrt{\frac{x - c}{a}} + \sqrt{\frac{y - c}{b}} = t$ ，则 $0 \leqslant t \leqslant 1$ 。 $l$ 与直线 $x = c, y = c$ 所围成的面积

$$
S (t) = \int_ {c} ^ {a t ^ {2} + c} d x \int_ {c} ^ {b t ^ {2} + \frac {b}{a} (x - c) + 2 b t \sqrt {\frac {x - c}{a}} + c} d y = \int_ {c} ^ {a t ^ {2} + c} \left[ b t ^ {2} + \frac {b}{a} (x - c) + 2 b t \sqrt {\frac {x - c}{a}} \right] d x = \frac {1}{6} a b t ^ {4}.
$$

选面积微元 $\mathrm{d}S = \frac{2}{3} abt^3\mathrm{d}t$ ，则

$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \cdot \frac {2}{3} a b t ^ {3} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{6} a b \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \mathrm{d} t ^ {4} = \frac {1}{6} a b \left(t ^ {4} \arctan t \Big | _ {0} ^ {1} - \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {t ^ {4}}{1 + t ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} t\right) = \frac {1}{9} a b.
$$

solution.final_answer: I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \cdot \frac {2}{3} a b t ^ {3} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{6} a b \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \mat

cdps.prompt: 本题积分区域/被积函数为何适合极坐标或极型换元？如何确定 ρ、φ 的上下限？
cdps.expected: 画区域、写极坐标方程或雅可比，化为累次积分。
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \cdot \frac {2}{3} a b t ^ {3} \mathrm{d} t = \frac {1}{6} a b \int_ {0} ^ {1} \arctan t \mat

meta.commentary: 评注 若积分区域的一条边界曲线是被积函数的等值线，则采用这种改变面积微元选取的方法，可起到降维的作用，将二重积分化为定积分，使计算更简单。这种方法也可推广到三重积分的情形。
